model.title: A resolution designating September 2026 as "National Literacy Month".

summary.text: The resolution designates September 2026 as National Literacy Month. It calls on the Federal Government, states, localities, schools, libraries, nonprofit organizations, businesses, and the people of the United States to observe the month with appropriate programs and activities.
